claude_proposed_widenings.name: species_trait_lineage_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current species-trait surface can only encode one passive bundle or one activation. Elven Lineage first asks the player to choose one of several mutually exclusive lineage bundles, and each bundle carries different mechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: level_gated_species_trait_grant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: After the initial lineage choice, the trait grants additional lineage-specific spells at character levels 3 and 5. Current species traits have no way to express deferred character-level unlocks inside one trait record.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: replaceable_spell_access_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf lineage grants a cantrip that can be replaced with a different Wizard cantrip after each Long Rest. Current grant_spell_access requires a fixed spellId and cannot express rest-based replacement within a closed source list.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
